blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Local stocks extended their rebound on Tuesday after the Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) signaled it could take a less aggressive approach to raising interest rates as economic growth slows. The benchmark Philippine Stock Exchange Index (PSEi) rose 1.93 percent, or 103.07 points, to close at 5,456.14. READ: Bangko Sentral rate-hiking run seen extending into 2027 The broader All Shares index gained 1.01 percent to 3,042.75. Luis Limlingan, head of sales at Regina Capital Development Corp., said the BSP’s signal offered investors some relief.
